lines.en: label toukastreets5:
scene toukaolddis1
I make my way over to the same area between my house and the[school] where I last found Touka battling a vending machine.
lines.zh: 我又走到家和学校之间那片区域——上次我就是在那儿撞见 Touka 跟一台贩卖机搏斗。

lines.en: Today, there is no battle. Just a girl standing in the middle of the sidewalk, curiously surveilling her surroundings and probably assigning new rich-person names to everyday commoner objects.
lines.zh: 今天没有搏斗。只有一个女孩站在人行道中央，好奇地打量四周，多半在给日常平民物件起新的「富人名字」。

lines.en: Or...trying to figure out how they work and-
lines.zh: 又或者……在琢磨这些东西怎么用——

lines.en: I don’t know. But she’s clearly confused to some extent because why else would anyone just stand around in the middle of a mild snowstorm?
lines.zh: 我不知道。但她显然有点懵，不然谁会在一场小雪里干站着？

lines.en: I make my way over soon after spotting her, letting the crunch of the ground beneath my feet signal my arrival.
lines.zh: 我一看见她就走了过去，让脚下碎雪的嘎吱声宣告我的到来。

lines.en: scene toukaolddis2
: Oh, Sensei. Good morning.
lines.zh: : 哦，Sensei。早上好。

lines.en: : If you had not shown up soon, I would have continued exploring on my own. Needless to say, I am very happy you did.
lines.zh: : 你要是没及时出现，我就自己接着逛了。不用说，你来了我很高兴。

lines.en: : So you {i}weren’t{/i} just standing around trying to figure out how commoner objects work? You were waiting for me?
lines.zh: : 所以你刚才{i}不是{/i}在原地琢磨平民物件怎么用？是在等我？

lines.en: scene toukaolddis3
: I may be inexperienced, but I am not an imbecile. I know how all of these things function.
lines.zh: : 我是没经验，但我不是白痴。这些东西怎么用我都知道。

lines.en: : So it’s just vending machines you have a problem with, then?
lines.zh: : 所以你搞不定的只有贩卖机？

lines.en: scene toukaolddis4
: In my defense, I do have experience with those types of machines. I had just never encountered one that wouldn’t accept my money before...
lines.zh: : 我得替自己说句公道话，我是用过那种机器的。我只是从没遇到过不收我钱的……

lines.en: : Let alone a voice activated one with an added visual element. But at least it is making the streets of Kumon-mi a safer place.
lines.zh: : 更别说还带个「视觉环节」的声控机了。不过至少，它让公文美的街道更安全了。

lines.en: Wait, does she still think I wasn’t joking about that part?
lines.zh: 等等，她还以为那段我没开玩笑？

lines.en: Please let me be around whenever she tries to use one again.
lines.zh: 求求了，下次她再用贩卖机，一定要让我在场。

lines.en: scene toukaolddis5
: So, can I assume that you are here to work as my guide and that you are not simply passing by?
lines.zh: : 那么，我可以当你是来给我当向导、而不是恰好路过吗？

lines.en: : Just passing by, actually. See you later.
lines.zh: : 其实是恰好路过。回头见。

lines.en: : Ha ha ha. That was a rhetorical question, Sensei. I know you are here to see me.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈。那是反问句，Sensei。我知道你是来见我的。

lines.en: : You do not need to be embarrassed.
lines.zh: : 你不用不好意思。

lines.en: : I’m sure that being out and about with me may make you look significantly worse by comparison, but there is barely anyone outside today.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，跟我一起出门，会显得你相形见绌，可今天外面几乎没什么人。

lines.en: : Yeah, that tends to happen when it snows. This area is a lot busier in the summer.
lines.zh: : 是啊，下雪天就这样。这片夏天热闹多了。

lines.en: : Also, being seen with you will not make me look worse.
lines.zh: : 再说，被人看见跟你在一起，也不会让我「丢脸」。

lines.en: : If anything, since most of the people out here are just like me, they’d probably just think {i}you{/i} look nice and not think anything of me at all.
lines.zh: : 要说的话，这儿的人都跟我一样，他们多半只会觉得「{i}你{/i}看着挺体面」，对我则根本不会多想。

lines.en: : I don’t see how that invalidates any of what I said, but as long as you will still be my tour guide, I can look past it.
lines.zh: : 我不明白这怎么推翻我说的话，不过只要你还肯当我的向导，我就不计较。

lines.en: : So, where would you have me go today?
lines.zh: : 那么，今天你要带我去哪儿？

lines.en: : Oh, it’s up to me?
lines.zh: : 哦，由我来定？

lines.en: scene toukaolddis2
: Well...yes.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……是的。

lines.en: : I know absolutely nothing about this area and you seem to know quite a bit.
lines.zh: : 我对这片一无所知，而你好像很熟。

lines.en: : Should I be researching places I would like to go and informing you of them beforehand?
lines.zh: : 我该先查好我想去的地方、提前告诉你吗？

lines.en: : I really don’t know the best way to approach things like this, nor where I should start for the authentic commoner experience.
lines.zh: : 我真不知道这种事该怎么办，也不知道从哪儿开始才算「地道的平民体验」。

lines.en: : Weren’t you supposed to stop using that word?
lines.zh: : 你不是该不用那个词了吗？

lines.en: scene toukaolddis6
: Yes, but...{i}lower middle class{/i} is so much harder to say. And it does not seem like you mind very much.
lines.zh: : 是，可是……{i}「中下阶层」{/i}念起来拗口多了。而且你好像也不太介意。

lines.en: : I don’t, really. Especially since I’ve called you a spoiled rich girl on several occasions now.
lines.zh: : 是不太介意。尤其我都叫过你好几次「被惯坏的富家女」了。

lines.en: scene toukaolddis7
: Spoiled?! Me?!
scene toukaolddis8
: Yes, I suppose that {i}is{/i} right now that I think about it.
lines.zh: : {i}是{/i}，现在想想，你说得对。

lines.en: : I apologize for my reaction. I’m just not used to being so accurately insulted.
lines.zh: : 我为我的反应道歉。我只是不习惯被人这么精准地羞辱。

lines.en: scene toukaolddis5
: But, that all ends today! Because I am going on a wholesome adventure with my teacher who is going to be very patient and encouraging with me!
lines.zh: : 不过，这一切今天为止！因为我要跟我的老师来一场健康的冒险——他会对我非常有耐心、非常鼓励的！

lines.en: : Patient, maybe. Encouraging, probably not.
lines.zh: : 耐心，也许吧。鼓励，多半不会。

lines.en: : Oh, stop. What could possibly go wrong?
lines.zh: : 哦，别这样。能出什么岔子？

lines.en: : I’m sure that wherever you take me will be somewhere I can ease into and experience at my own pace.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，你带我去的地方，我都能慢慢适应、按自己的节奏体验。

lines.en: : Only a {i}truly{/i} horrible man would toss me into the deep end. And you are only partially horrible based on what I’ve seen thus far.
lines.zh: : 只有{i}真正{/i}可怕的男人才会把我直接「扔进深水区」。而据我目前所见，你只有一半可怕。

lines.en: scene black
: You know, I think I've got just the place.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我想到个地方了。

lines.en: : It’s kind of a long walk, though.
lines.zh: : 不过路有点远。

lines.en: : That’s fine! I’ve packed plenty of snacks and beverages for the two of us and slept surprisingly well last night!
lines.zh: : 没关系！我带足了咱们俩的零食和饮料，而且昨晚睡得格外好！

lines.en: : What if I didn’t show up today?
lines.zh: : 万一我今天没来呢？

lines.en: : Well...I suppose I would have had to find something else to do with all of the items I brought.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……那我只能另想办法用掉我带来的这些东西了。

lines.en: : Regardless! I am refreshed and raring to go!
lines.zh: : 不管怎样！我精神饱满、整装待发！

lines.en: : Lead the way, Sensei! I’m sure you will take me somewhere nice!
lines.zh: : 带路吧，Sensei！我相信你会带我去个好地方！

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : We’ll see about that.
lines.zh: : 那可不一定。

lines.en: scene wintersky
Now, “nice” is a subjective term a lot of the time.
lines.zh: 要知道，「好」这个词，很多时候是主观的。

lines.en: There are things certain people find interesting or endearing that others can’t seem to grasp even after prolonged exposure or being forced to consume or experience them.
lines.zh: 有些东西，某些人觉得有意思或可爱，另一些人就算长期接触、被硬塞，也没法理解。

lines.en: Basically, there are things that you can “train” yourself to like.
lines.zh: 基本上，有些东西你是可以「训练」自己去喜欢的。

lines.en: And right now, essentially everything Touka can and will experience falls into that exact boat.
lines.zh: 而眼下，Touka 能体验到、将要体验到的一切，基本都属于这一类。

lines.en: Of course she’d never view any of what us “normal people” see as nice when she’s been conditioned to accept nothing less than the best of what life has to offer.
lines.zh: 她从小被调教得只接受「生活所能提供的最好」，所以当然不会把我们「普通人」眼里的「好」当回事。

lines.en: So, with that in mind, the best course of action right now isn’t to slowly ease her into the life that everyone else leads.
lines.zh: 所以，鉴于此，眼下最好的做法，不是慢慢引导她适应别人过的生活。

lines.en: It’s to do exactly as she {i}doesn’t{/i} want me to do and toss her into the deep end.
lines.zh: 而是反其道而行——做她{i}不{/i}让我做的事：把她直接扔进深水区。

lines.en: But that’s okay, because I’m sure her exceedingly rich family has paid for years worth of swimming lessons.
lines.zh: 不过没关系，我敢肯定她那富得流油的家，早就给她买够了多年的游泳课。

lines.en: And I’m sure that if they didn’t and she winds up drowning, they’ll throw a lavish funeral to celebrate her depressingly short life.
lines.zh: 而且我敢肯定，要是没买、她真淹死了，他们也会办一场奢华的葬礼，来「庆祝」她短暂得令人沮丧的一生。

lines.en: Either way, I know where I’m taking her.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我知道要带她去哪了。

lines.en: And it’s somewhere that no amount of snacks or beverages can possibly prepare her for.
lines.zh: 而且那地方，多少零食饮料都没法让她做好准备。

lines.en: scene toukaolddis9
: Where...are we?...
lines.zh: : 我们……到哪儿了？……

lines.en: : This is the second half of town. Or the old district, if you’d rather call it that instead.
lines.zh: : 这是这座城的另一半。或者你愿意的话，叫它「老城区」。

lines.en: : Is this...some sort of theme park? What am I looking at here?
lines.zh: : 这是……什么主题乐园吗？我看到的是什么？

lines.en: : Not a theme park. Just a low income area where people even worse off than me live.
lines.zh: : 不是主题乐园。只是个低收入区，住着比我还落魄的人。

lines.en: : I figured it might help to show you the polar opposite of your life rather than something boring like a bowling alley or an ice skating rink.
lines.zh: : 我想，与其带你看保龄球馆、溜冰场那种无聊地方，不如给你看看你人生的「完全对立面」。

lines.en: scene toukaolddis10
: I love ice skating, actually. Would you like to accompany me some day?
lines.zh: : 我其实很喜欢滑冰。改天你愿意陪我去吗？

lines.en: : Not particularly.
lines.zh: : 不太愿意。

lines.en: : How sad.
lines.zh: : 真扫兴。

lines.en: scene toukaolddis11
: This place, though...
lines.zh: : 不过这个地方……

lines.en: : You said that people...{i}live{/i} here?
lines.zh: : 你是说有人……{i}住{/i}在这儿？

lines.en: : {i}Die{/i} here is probably more accurate.
lines.zh: : 说「{i}死{/i}在这儿」大概更准确。

lines.en: : Most of the people in the old district are either...well, {i}old{/i} or homeless. Or a mixture of both of those two things.
lines.zh: : 老城区的人大多要么……很{i}老{/i}，要么无家可归。要么两样都占。

lines.en: : But that doesn’t mean there aren’t outliers.
lines.zh: : 但这不代表没有例外。

lines.en: scene toukaolddis12
: You don’t mean to tell me that there are students in our[school] who call a place like this home, do you?
lines.zh: : 你该不是要告诉我，我们[学校]里有学生把这种地方当「家」吧？

lines.en: : There are a few in our class, actually.
lines.zh: : 其实我们班就有几个。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo...Chika...That one girl you find more intimidating than me who I can’t remember the name of.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo……Chika……还有那个你觉得比我还吓人、可我记不住名字的女孩。

lines.en: scene toukaolddis13
: I...suppose I do see how someone like Yumi could live here. She needed to learn her...intimidation tactics somewhere.
lines.zh: : 我……大概能想象 Yumi 那种人住在这儿。她总得有地方学她那套……吓人本事。

lines.en: : But you say that Chika lives here as well? The one who my mother is familiar with?
lines.zh: : 可你说 Chika 也住这儿？就是我母亲认识的那个？

lines.en: : Yeah. Her and Yumi live in an apartment over here together.
lines.zh: : 对。她和 Yumi 一起住在这边的一套公寓里。

lines.en: : They’re taking care of a little girl with an immunodeficiency disorder as well.
lines.zh: : 她们还在照顾一个患有免疫缺陷疾病的小女孩。

lines.en: : It’s pretty impressive, to tell you the truth.
lines.zh: : 说实话，挺了不起的。

lines.en: scene toukaolddis14
: This isn’t another one of your pranks, is it?
lines.zh: : 这不是你又一个恶作剧吧？

lines.en: : Because I can be depressingly compassionate at times, and it would be very mean for you to make me feel bad about things that simply aren’t true.
lines.zh: : 因为我这人有时候会多愁善感到可悲的地步，你要拿些根本不是真的事来让我难过，就太缺德了。

lines.en: : It’s true. I’d take you there, but Chika doesn’t let just anyone near her sister since it could get her sick.
lines.zh: : 是真的。我本想带你去，可 Chika 不让随便什么人靠近她妹妹，怕她生病。

lines.en: scene toukaolddis15
: I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : So she really does live here after all.
lines.zh: : 所以她真的住在这儿。

lines.en: : You're not crying again, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会又哭了吧？

lines.en: : I am. But can I truly be blamed for that?
lines.zh: : 哭了。可这真能怪我吗？

lines.en: : This news comes as a bit of a shock to me, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这消息让我有点震惊，Sensei。

lines.en: : My initial reaction was asking if this place was a theme park.
lines.zh: : 我的第一反应居然是问「这是不是什么主题乐园」。

lines.en: : I didn’t think for a moment that there were people, let alone ones as kind as that girl, {i}living{/i} in a place like this.
lines.zh: : 我压根没想过会有人{i}住{/i}在这儿——更别说像那个女孩那么善良的人。

lines.en: scene toukaolddis16
: And taking care of a sick little girl as well...
lines.zh: : 而且还在照顾一个生病的小女孩……

lines.en: : I guess taking you here was a bad idea after all, huh?
lines.zh: : 看来带你来这儿终究是个坏主意，是吧？

lines.en: : No. In fact, hiding this from me would have made me feel even worse.
lines.zh: : 不。恰恰相反，瞒着我只会让我更难受。

lines.en: : At least now I can try to wrap my head around how things could have possibly gotten to this point.
lines.zh: : 至少现在，我能试着想明白事情怎么会变成这样。

lines.en: : We’ve only been here for several minutes and I already can’t fathom the idea of calling this area “home.”
lines.zh: : 我们才来几分钟，可我已经无法想象把这种地方叫「家」是什么滋味。

lines.en: scene toukaolddis17
: There are people slumped up against walls...tucked into alleyways and trying to keep themselves warm.
lines.zh: : 有人瘫倒在墙边……缩在小巷里，努力给自己取暖。

lines.en: : It’s snowing, Sensei. They’re going to get sick. Perhaps even worse.
lines.zh: : 下雪了，Sensei。他们会生病的。说不定更糟。

lines.en: : Probably. But that’s just the hand these people were dealt.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。可这就是发到他们手里的牌。

lines.en: : We’re lucky to be where we are with that in mind.
lines.zh: : 这么一想，我们能处在现在的位置已经很幸运了。

lines.en: : Lucky is an absolute understatement. This is abhorrent and I will not stand for it.
lines.zh: : 「幸运」都远远说轻了。这太恶劣了，我无法容忍。

lines.en: scene toukaolddis18
: Excuse me! Can you tell me your name?
lines.zh: : 打扰一下！能告诉我你的名字吗？

lines.en: Touka wanders away from me for a moment and crouches down beside an old man half-asleep near the side of a rundown house.
lines.zh: Touka 从我身边走开几步，蹲在一栋破败房子旁一位半睡的老人身边。

lines.en: I can’t make out the look on his face from where I stand, but I notice a distinct lack of teeth as he opens his mouth to try and respond to Touka.
lines.zh: 我站的地方看不清他的表情，但我注意到：他张嘴想回应 Touka 时，明显缺了几颗牙。

lines.en: She proceeds to reach into her bag and pull out a handful of snacks for the man, placing them neatly beside him.
lines.zh: 她接着从包里掏出一把零食，整整齐齐摆在他身旁。

lines.en: His eyes light up and, for a brief moment in time, things are less horrible.
lines.zh: 他的眼睛亮了，短短一瞬间，一切没那么糟了。

lines.en: : Hi there...My name is Touka.
lines.zh: : 你好……我叫 Touka。

lines.en: : Are you cold?
lines.zh: : 你冷吗？

lines.en: : You poor thing...
lines.zh: : 可怜的人……

lines.en: : You can’t even talk, can you?
lines.zh: : 你连话都说不了了，是吗？

lines.en: : I don’t have much on me at the moment, but please take all of this. You need it much more than I do.
lines.zh: : 我身上现在没带多少东西，不过请把这些都收下吧。你比我更需要它们。

lines.en: : Don’t worry about thanking me. Just eat and try to stay warm, okay? The snow will only last so-
lines.zh: : 不用谢我。吃点东西、尽量保暖，好吗？这场雪下不了多——

lines.en: scene ayhh2
scene ayhh4
scene ayhh10
scene ayhh7
scene ayhh8
scene toukaolddis19
: Uhhhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……

lines.en: : Sensei, what is this place?
lines.zh: : Sensei，这是什么地方？

lines.en: : Before that, what is this pairing?
lines.zh: : 在那之前，你们俩这是什么组合？

lines.en: : Since when do the two of you hang out outside of[school]?
lines.zh: : 你们俩什么时候开始在[学校]外面混了？

lines.en: scene toukaolddis20
: Uhh...let’s see...Noriko, correct?
lines.zh: : 呃……我想想……Noriko，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah...
: And you’re Touka, right?
lines.zh: : 而你是 Touka，对吧？

lines.en: : Right! Though our teacher seems to forget that rather frequently.
lines.zh: : 对！不过我们老师好像老是记不住。

lines.en: : Sensei was just giving me a tour of the old district as it is my first time here.
lines.zh: : Sensei 正带我逛老城区，这是我第一次来。

lines.en: : Then he suggested something about wanting to come here, but was so taken aback by my generosity moments before that he has been mostly speechless ever since.
lines.zh: : 然后他提了句想来这儿，结果被几分钟前我的「慷慨」惊到了，从那以后基本就没说话。

lines.en: scene toukaolddis21
: Is this a...shop of some sorts?
lines.zh: : 这是一家……商店之类的吗？

lines.en: : Do you mind if I take a quick look around? There are so many interesting things here.
lines.zh: : 你介意我随便看看吗？这儿有好多有意思的东西。

lines.en: : Uhh, yeah. Go ahead.
lines.zh: : 呃，行。看吧。

lines.en: : Splendid!
lines.zh: : 太好了！

lines.en: scene toukaolddis22
Touka begins to look around the store and I find myself slightly confused and standing at the counter with Noriko.
lines.zh: Touka 开始在店里转悠，我则有点发懵地站在柜台边，跟 Noriko 在一起。

lines.en: scene toukaolddis23
: Hey...are you okay? You seem kind of out of it right now.
lines.zh: : 嘿……你还好吗？你这会儿有点魂不守舍的。

lines.en: : I...think so?
lines.zh: : 我……想还行吧？

lines.en: : I remember walking around with Touka, but I don’t really remember anything about coming over here.
lines.zh: : 我记得我在跟 Touka 逛街，可我不太记得是怎么走到这儿来的。

lines.en: : Hmm...
scene toukaolddis24
: Maybe you just realized that a trip to the old district without coming to see me is no trip at all?!
lines.zh: : 也许你只是突然意识到：来了老城区却不来看我，等于白来一趟？！

lines.en: : Sure, let’s go with that.
lines.zh: : 对，就当是这样吧。

lines.en: : Since when do you work mornings, though?
lines.zh: : 话说，你什么时候开始上早班了？

lines.en: scene toukaolddis25
: I don’t really have a set schedule. I just kinda work whenever I want to work and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我其实没什么固定班表。想上班就上班，就这样。

lines.en: : Today just happens to be one of those days.
lines.zh: : 今天恰好就是那种日子。

lines.en: : Is it my turn to ask a question now?
lines.zh: : 现在轮到我提问了吗？

lines.en: : I mean, you’re going to ask it anyway, so sure.
lines.zh: : 反正你横竖都要问，行吧。

lines.en: : Why are you showing her around the old district?
lines.zh: : 你为什么带她逛老城区？

lines.en: : I get that you like to hang out with everybody and stuff, but...it seems like kind of a weird place to take {i}her{/i} of all people.
lines.zh: : 我知道你喜欢跟谁都混一块儿，可是……偏偏带{i}她{/i}来这儿，是不是有点怪？

lines.en: : That’s exactly why I brought her here.
lines.zh: : 我带她来正是为这个。

lines.en: : She’s been having trouble getting accustomed to the life of a middle class citizen and-
lines.zh: : 她一直很难适应中产阶级的生活，而且——

lines.en: : Sensei! What are these?!
lines.zh: : Sensei！这些是什么？！

lines.en: : Hold on one second, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 等一下，Noriko。

lines.en: scene toukaolddis26
: Touka, what-
lines.zh: : Touka，怎么——

lines.en: : Are these candy?! Can we buy some?!
lines.zh: : 这些是糖果吗？！我们能买点吗？！

lines.en: : {i}Oooooooooooooooooooh my god.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦哦哦——我的天。{/i}

lines.en: : I’m not normally allowed to eat candy on account of what it can do to my body, but today is a special occasion and-
lines.zh: : 我平常不能吃糖，因为它对我的身体不好，可今天是特别的日子，而且——

lines.en: : Touka, I’m going to need you to listen very carefully for a moment.
lines.zh: : Touka，我需要你现在仔细听我说。

lines.en: scene toukaolddis27
: Listen to what? Did I do something wrong?
lines.zh: : 听什么？我做错什么了吗？

lines.en: : This isn’t actually a museum, is it? There were price tags, so I assumed I could purchase the items on display and-
lines.zh: : 这其实不是博物馆，对吧？上面有价签，所以我以为我可以买这些陈列品——

lines.en: : Those are condoms.
lines.zh: : 那是避孕套。

lines.en: : Condoms?
lines.zh: : 避孕套？

lines.en: : Not candy.
lines.zh: : 不是糖果。

lines.en: : Not candy?
lines.zh: : 不是糖果？

lines.en: : Welcome in!
lines.zh: : 欢迎光临！

lines.en: : You can’t eat condoms, Touka.
lines.zh: : 避孕套不能吃，Touka。

lines.en: : Bye! Please come again!
lines.zh: : 慢走！欢迎下次再来！

lines.en: scene toukaolddis28
: Hmm...condoms...
lines.zh: : 嗯……避孕套……

lines.en: : I feel as if I’ve heard that word before. But what did it mean again?
lines.zh: : 我好像在哪儿听过这个词。可它是什么意思来着？

lines.en: : I’m sure your mother or...manor staff must have taught you sexual education, right?
lines.zh: : 你母亲或者……宅里的佣人肯定教过你性教育吧？

lines.en: : Yes, but what would-
lines.zh: : 教过，可那跟——

lines.en: scene toukaolddis29
: Ah!
: You remembered?
lines.zh: : 你想起来了？

lines.en: scene toukaolddis30
: I remembered.
lines.zh: : 想起来了。

lines.en: : This is extremely embarrassing.
lines.zh: : 这也太丢人了。

lines.en: : Just think of how it would be if you tried to eat them.
lines.zh: : 你想想，要是你真把它们吃了会怎样。

lines.en: : I have sullied your good name by acting so inappropriately in public.
lines.zh: : 我在公共场合做出那么不得体的举动，败坏了你的好名声。

lines.en: : And after you took the time out of your day to show me a true middle class...sex shop?
lines.zh: : 而且还是在你特意抽时间带我见识真正的中产阶级……情趣用品店之后？

lines.en: : Convenience store. They just sell condoms because it’s...convenient, I guess.
lines.zh: : 便利店。他们卖避孕套纯粹是因为……方便，大概吧。

lines.en: : But you can also buy snacks and drinks here as well.
lines.zh: : 不过这儿也能买零食和饮料。

lines.en: : Doesn’t it make people feel strange buying food and beverages from a store that sells contraceptives?
lines.zh: : 在一家卖避孕套的店里买吃的喝的，不会让人觉得怪怪的吗？

lines.en: : Surprisingly, no.
lines.zh: : 意外地，不会。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: : Are you ready to leave now?
lines.zh: : 你现在想走了吗？

lines.en: : Yes. I believe I am.
lines.zh: : 想。我想走了。

lines.en: scene black
Touka and I say goodbye to Noriko without purchasing anything.
lines.zh: Touka 和我什么都没买，就跟 Noriko 道了别。

lines.en: She proceeds to confusedly wave at us as we depart the store and I receive a flurry of text messages moments later with nothing but question marks.
lines.zh: 我们离店时，她一脸困惑地朝我们挥手；没过几分钟，我收到一连串全是问号的短信。

lines.en: Not knowing how to reply, I slide my phone back into my pocket and slowly escort the richest girl in Kumon-mi back to the safer part of town.
lines.zh: 不知道该怎么回，我把手机塞回口袋，慢慢把这个公文美最有钱的女孩护送回城里更安全的那半边。

lines.en: I got to see a different side of her today, though.
lines.zh: 不过，今天我看到了她不一样的一面。

lines.en: And a side that, while overwhelmingly naive, is still endearing.
lines.zh: 这一面虽然天真到不行，却依然惹人喜爱。

lines.en: I just hope she doesn’t wind up trying to get too involved in things she doesn’t understand.
lines.zh: 我只希望她别到头来，过度卷入那些她不懂的事。

lines.en: I may have taken her there today, but I don’t think a place like that is really fit for a girl like Touka.
lines.zh: 今天是我带她去的，可我觉得那种地方，并不适合 Touka 这样的女孩。

lines.en: Eventually, we wind up back near the vending machines where this all started and go our separate ways.
lines.zh: 最后，我们回到一切开始的那几台贩卖机附近，分道扬镳。

lines.en: Instead of just standing around staring during today’s separation, though, I can hear Touka softly humming something to herself as she gleefully skips away.
lines.zh: 不过今天分别时，她没有干站着发愣——我听见她轻声哼着什么，兴高采烈地蹦跳着走远了。
